newsitem.title: USA: Utilities seek FERC review of Enova/PET merger.
newsitem.headline: Utilities seek FERC review of Enova/PET merger.

text.p: Groups representing municipal utilities and rural electric cooperatives said Friday they have asked the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Friday to review the planned merger of Enova Corp and Pacific Enterprises.
Enova, parent of San Diego Gas and Electric Co, and PET, parent of Southern California Gas Co, have petitioned for exemption of their merger proposal from FERC review.

The utilities argued that a broad range of other state and federal agencies will be required to review the deal and the combination of a gas and an electric utility does not come under FERC jurisdiction.
But the American Public Power Association (APPA) and the National Rural Electric Cooperative Association said in Friday's filing that FERC review is needed on both legal and policy grounds.
In light of the federal commission's statement last month on merger policies, protection of competition should be a paramount goal for FERC, the groups said.
